AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#322 @ 23435ec2c099aa5e25c8c0737d92662b73c83855 — VERDICT: APPROVE

Independent **T4 delta from this lens's `0b4813dc` REQUEST CHANGES**, paired with backend #628's current quote/result contract; **open A/B/C = 0/0/2**. All three mobile required checks are SUCCESS at the exact head; approval does not waive backend-first deployment, flag or native-device gates. ([Prior Sol verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5960166963), [FIX ROUND 6](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964634707), [candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322))

### Prior Sol findings

- **B-322-1 closed:** a failed/rejected bank step re-confirms the same SetupIntent/approval before making a money claim, shows a settled outcome when available, otherwise builds bank-error copy from known per-currency paid/due totals or states uncertainty. Same-mounted-screen retry supplies `lastKnown` and retains Confirm with my bank / Use a different card; candidate tests cover partial-paid recheck, rejection/lost recheck, actual settled recheck and screen retry. ([Actual bank flow](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/23435ec2c099aa5e25c8c0737d92662b73c83855/src/entitlements/dunning/updateCard.ts), [regressions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/23435ec2c099aa5e25c8c0737d92662b73c83855/src/entitlements/dunning/__tests__/nativeCardUpdate.test.tsx))
- **B-322-5 closed on the retained quote boundary:** quote normalization now requires `complete:true`, lines/totals, unique invoice IDs and total currencies, and exact per-currency line-sum agreement. Missing/inconsistent quotes stop before the sheet with specific reference/support copy, while the complete empty quote remains Save card; approval and displayed totals therefore no longer diverge in the reproduced case. ([Strict quote](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/23435ec2c099aa5e25c8c0737d92662b73c83855/src/entitlements/dunning/dunningApi.ts), [negative and empty/multi-currency tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/23435ec2c099aa5e25c8c0737d92662b73c83855/src/entitlements/dunning/__tests__/nativeCardUpdate.test.tsx))
- **B-322-7 closed:** `in_progress` is typed/validated, known paid amounts are shown, and Check again reuses the same confirm body without another sheet. The backend-produced fixture and current backend composer both have the corresponding valid outcome and complete quote; this is a contract check, not approval of backend #628. ([Client contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/23435ec2c099aa5e25c8c0737d92662b73c83855/src/entitlements/dunning/dunningApi.ts), [mounted retry](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/23435ec2c099aa5e25c8c0737d92662b73c83855/src/entitlements/dunning/UpdateCardScreen.tsx), [paired backend](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/628))
- **C-322-2 closed:** processing copy leads with amounts already paid; earlier B-322-2/3/4/6 and C-322-1 closures remain intact on their previously audited scope. Support failures now use the shared address/select/copy/retry fallback and preserve the request reference rather than direct per-screen mailto calls. ([Fix/test record](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964634707), [earlier dispositions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5960166963))

### C / release limits

**C-322-3 carried — #334 composition:** whichever PR merges second must retain the native UpdateCard route at the ClientPackages past-due-banner conflict; no hosted portal fallback may reappear. ([Other-lens composition finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964778187))

**C-322-4 — Remount evidence is a helper-level test, not a mounted-screen recovery proof.** The test labelled “after a remount” directly calls `confirmWithBank` with a hand-supplied SetupIntent, secret and `lastKnown`; it does not unmount/recreate UpdateCardScreen. The actual screen holds those values in React state/ref and supplies `lastKnown` only from that state, so this test does not establish crash/restart restoration of the existing bank action. Add a true lifecycle test and an account-bound non-secret recovery locator if same-action continuity across remount is required; do not label the direct helper test a device/remount pass. No false zero-payment branch is newly demonstrated here, hence optional rather than reopening B-322-1. ([Test and supplied context](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/23435ec2c099aa5e25c8c0737d92662b73c83855/src/entitlements/dunning/__tests__/nativeCardUpdate.test.tsx), [actual state/retry](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/23435ec2c099aa5e25c8c0737d92662b73c83855/src/entitlements/dunning/UpdateCardScreen.tsx))

Backend #628 must be independently approved/merged/deployed before this client relies on its complete quote and `in_progress` result; FEATURE_DUNNING_V2 remains OFF unless the operator authorizes activation. iOS/Android PaymentSheet/ephemeral-key compatibility, real 3DS/redirect and universal-link acceptance are still release gates, not certified by SDK doubles. ([Builder release contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322), [independent other-lens release order](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964778187))

### Evidence

Read all prior AUDIT/FIX comments and the complete own runtime/test changes in `2d808dc`, `e12d40c`, `23435ec`; both main merges reproduce exact automatic trees: `79ea4d2 → 18f2a5b87a574ef57306467a8df6c1f7c81b2931`, `91c1941 → 3ad1d8b0844adf3fabb82e8fa6c54ab0b3624aff`. The mistakenly committed node_modules symlink is absent from the head tree, and no new native dependency install was used for this audit. ([Candidate/change record](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964634707))

Independent targeted `ops/heavy.sh npx jest --runInBand`: `nativeCardUpdate`, `dunningLockout`, `supportEmail.guard`, `rootNavigatorConsultationColdBoot`, `rootNavigatorConsultationComplete` — **5 suites / 102 passed**. Evidence retained in `ops/aud-sol-114b/322-{source-delta.diff,comments.json,tests.log,final-snapshot.json,verdict.md}`; no push, merge, dispatch or production action. ([Exact candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322))
